thread:
anika: quick sync 1: we need a defensible priority selector + acceptance rubric for the next design-partner wave. aim: 8-10 partners, 6 weeks, mixed hosted/private. want a compact decision flow for invites + clear stop/pivot triggers. thoughts?

rob: high level: minimize ops risk early. Suggest a 2-track invite: "fast-hosted" (low infra impact) and "private-eval" (higher touch). Fast-hosted gets lighter gates, private gets stricter gating and legal checks.

cheng: +1. Proposed selector weights: production intent (30%), integration lead availability (20%), infra risk (20%), product fit (20%), quick-win potential (10%). Auto-accept threshold >=70%. Manual review 50-69%. Decline <50%.

selena: Love the weights. For private-eval we should require: signed DPA, named legal/compliance contact, and an on-prem checklist completed before any private slot is reserved. legal-bot can confirm timelines.

legal-bot: DPA turnaround ~4-7 business days depending on CLA complexity. Flagging any regulated partner as "legal-block" until intake is approved. Recommend not scheduling private runs until legal clears.

ops-bot: Infra note: private capacity constrained to 3 concurrent full-evals. Reserve 1 slot per week for hotfix verification. If we run waves of 3, we need a 2-week stagger to avoid resource spikes.

anika: Good. Let's be explicit in the acceptance rubric. Minimal required items (hard gates): 1) integration kickoff confirmed (named owner + first sync within 10 days), 2) telemetry enabled (request_id + sampled traces), 3) perf baseline collected (p50/p95 tokens), 4) legal flag cleared if private. Soft metrics (scored): partner impact, engineering bandwidth, product fit.

rob: For perf baselines propose p95 hosted < 400ms as a starting bar; private can be p95 < 500ms but we accept more variance depending on infra. Also define a cost delta threshold (e.g., token-cost change < 2x) so we don't push partners into huge spend.

cheng: On measuring correctness: require 12 deterministic prompts (partner + our control) run weekly. Compute weekly pass rate. If pass rate drops >7% vs baseline for 2 consecutive weeks unlock the "eval incident" flow and fallback to a stable variant.

selena: Add business/engagement metrics: partner satisfaction survey at week3 & week6 (5 questions) and a measure of "actionable outcomes" (number of product changes influenced). We want at least 2 partners to express roadmap intent to consider pilot-to-prod after the program.

anika: Recruitment mix idea: 60% existing active hosted users, 25% platform/on-prem interested, 15% new logos. Reserve one slot for a regulated candidate if legal clears within 7 days.

rob: Incentives: credits + 4 office-hours of solutions support for first 3 private partners, plus case study offer. Solutions team signoff needed for grants.

selena: Stop/pivot criteria proposal: immediate pause triggers: 1) more than 40% of active partners report blocker-level issues for >72h, 2) private infra utilization >80% for >5 days, 3) >30% partners miss integration kickoff by day 10. If triggered, we pause invites and run a 2-week remediation window.

cheng: Also add a soft pause: if automated eval pass rate median falls <85% across partners for 2 consecutive weeks, we slow invites and escalate.

anika: On intake UX: include fields - partner intent (proof-of-value vs prod-pilot), integration owner (name/email), legal/regulatory flag, streaming workload Y/N, expected qps, top 3 success criteria. That will help auto-score.

rob: Exclusions to call out explicitly in invite copy: major streaming workloads, heavy batch backfills, and non-sanctioned data sources. We can allow small sampling tests but not full production ingestion.

selena: Legal addition: regulated partners must provide a data-flow diagram + security contact. We'll queue DPA review, but we can start hosted evaluation (if applicable) in parallel with a restricted telemetry plan.

ops-bot: Ops asks: stagger waves by 10-14 days; avoid scheduling quantization experiments in week1-2; tag every private run with a "wave-id" for capacity dashboards. I'll provide the reservation sheet.

cheng: Feedback cadence: weekly 30m sync + private channel + async NPS-style pulse after key milestones. Also require partners to fill a short 6-question form after integration and after handoff.

anika: Good. Let's capture action items and owners now. 1) anika: finalize selector weights + publish intake form (due Mon) 2) rob: draft invite copy with explicit exclusions & incentives (due Mon) 3) cheng: build eval prompt harness + baseline script (due Tue) 4) selena: confirm legal timelines for DPA + regulated slot (due Wed) 5) ops-bot: publish private slot reservation sheet & wave template (due Tue).

rob: One more ask: add a short "de-risking" offer in the invite: 2-week focused onboarding + one guaranteed smoke-test slot within first 14 days. Helps close deals faster.

selena: OK from legal if we limit the smoke-test to non-production data and keep audit logs. Also require partner sign-off on telemetry sharing.

anika: ok we'll add that. Any objections?

cheng: none from me. Also suggest tagging each partner with a "risk level" (low/med/high) after intake so we prioritize support.

anika: Agreed. Final note: let's keep the initial wave small and measurable. We'll iterate on thresholds after a 6-week review. Thanks team 1 :rocket:
